title: Check budget and approve/deny AI agent spending with x402 payment verification
description: Check budget and approve/deny AI agent spending with x402 payment verification

_signals.x_guidance: This API provides x402-paid governance tools for autonomous AI agents. Agents should call /api/budget/check before making paid API calls to verify per-request and daily spending limits. Use /api/budget/record to persist budget decisions, /api/record-payment to log completed x402 payments, and /api/classify-invoice to classify invoice or payment records. The API is useful for AI agent spending control, payment governance, budget limits, audit logging, USDC payments on Base, JPYC/JPY reporting workflows, and preventing unexpected paid tool calls.
